stories.title: Italiaanse bank voor miljoenen opgelicht met deepfake AI-stem

en.title: Italian bank defrauded of millions with deepfake AI voice
en.summary: Italy's largest bank, Intesa Sanpaolo, fell victim to fraud involving artificial intelligence deepfake technology. Perpetrators used a synthetic voice impersonating the CEO to deceive officials and steal tens of millions of euros beginning in February.

stories.title: Grote Italiaanse bank voor tientallen miljoenen opgelicht door misleiding met AI

en.title: Major Italian bank defrauded of tens of millions through AI deception
en.summary: A large Italian bank suffered significant financial losses in a fraud scheme involving AI-based deception techniques.

stories.title: Van Bommel debuteert als bondscoach van België met zege op Italië

en.title: Van Bommel debuts as Belgium coach with victory over Italy
en.summary: Van Bommel made his debut as Belgium's head coach, securing a 2-0 win against Italy.

stories.title: Van Bommel beleeft mede door Godts droomstart bij België met zege in Italië

en.title: Van Bommel experiences dream start at Belgium with victory in Italy, aided by Godts
en.summary: Van Bommel enjoyed a successful debut as Belgium's coach, with the team defeating Italy 2-0, including Mika Godts scoring his first international goal.

stories.title: Man op klaarlichte dag doodgeschoten op vol terras in Amsterdam

en.title: Man shot dead in broad daylight at busy terrace in Amsterdam
en.summary: A man was fatally shot in daylight at a crowded terrace in Amsterdam.

stories.title: Dode vinvis van 11 meter aangespoeld op strand Ameland: 'Niet veel van over'

en.title: Dead whale of 11 meters washed ashore on Ameland beach: 'Not much left'
en.summary: An 11-meter-long dead whale washed ashore on a beach in Ameland on Friday morning. The carcass, which has been dead for some time, remains on the beach.

stories.title: Kabinet laat onderzoek doen naar misstanden bij zaaddonaties

en.title: Government launches investigation into seed donation abuses
en.summary: The Dutch health ministry is commissioning an independent historical investigation to understand how irregularities in donor conception practices have occurred.

stories.title: Pro in Europa bij sociaaldemocraten; Kitty Jong wordt partijvoorzitter

en.title: Kitty Jong becomes chair of Pro, which joins European social democrats
en.summary: Kitty Jong was elected chair of Progressive Netherlands (Pro), the merged left-wing party, which will join the European social democrats rather than the Greens.

stories.title: Minderheidskabinet spreekt met oppositie over 'nieuw, aantrekkelijk aanbod'

en.title: Minority cabinet speaks with opposition about 'new, attractive offer'
en.summary: The Dutch minority government continues negotiations with opposition parties on budget support. Premier Jetten announced a new package addressing purchasing power, social security, and wealth tax aimed at securing support from both left and right.

stories.title: Pro sluit zich aan bij Europese Socialisten, oud-FNV’er Kitty Jong nieuwe partijvoorzitter

en.title: Pro joins European Socialists, former FNV member Kitty Jong new party chair
en.summary: Progressief Nederland has voted to join the European Socialist Party at the European level, with party members approving the decision through referendum. Kitty Jong, a former FNV official, has been appointed as the new party chairperson.

stories.title: Man doodgeschoten op druk terras in Amsterdam, vuurwapen gevonden in het IJ

en.title: Man shot dead at busy terrace in Amsterdam, firearm found in the IJ
en.summary: A man was fatally shot at a crowded terrace on the NDSM-kade in Amsterdam on Friday afternoon. Police arrested a suspect and recovered a firearm from the water.

stories.title: Pro sluit zich in Europa aan bij de Europese socialisten, Kitty Jong partijvoorzitter

en.title: Pro joins European socialists in Europe, Kitty Jong party chairperson
en.summary: Progressief Nederland has aligned itself with the European Socialists at the European level, with Kitty Jong becoming the party's chairperson.
